newsitem.title: UK: Australia's AMP wants UK insurance mutual - paper.
newsitem.headline: Australia's AMP wants UK insurance mutual - paper.

text.p: Australian Mutual Provident (AMP) is planning a two billion pound ($3.3 billion) takeover for mutually-owned life insurance company National Provident Institution (NPI), the Sunday Telegraph said.
Observers of both companies told the paper that AMP had written to NPI demanding talks about an offer and making clear it was prepared to appeal directly to the company's policyholders if necessary.

NPI, with 10 billion pounds in assets under management, has recognised that its days as a mutual company are numbered and is appointing advisers to work on either a flotation or an auction to sell the business to the highest bidder, the paper said.
Earlier this month AMP was pipped by Prudential Corp Plc in the battle to buy insurance group Scottish Amicable.
